annotations.title: Split an image into editable layers

description: Split ONE finished static ad (or any picture) into a BASE image plus separately editable transparent PNG LAYERS: each text block, the product, the logo, a person, badges, buttons and shapes come out on their own layer at their original position (each layer's box in base-image pixels), and the base keeps the background with the gaps filled. The words of every ordinary text layer are READ OUT (the text, each line's box, an approximate font, colour, bold, italic), so a designer or an agent can change the copy, translate it or rebuild the ad in a design tool. `layers` = how many layers at most (default 6, up to 20; the base is extra and every picture returned is billed). `prompt` names what to lift (e.g. 'only the headline and the product'). dryRun:true = the price, nothing made. To change the ad itself rather than take it apart, use edit_image.

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

image.description: the picture: an https / upload_file URL, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI; 512x512 to 6000x6000 pixels

layers.description: the most layers to return besides the base (default 6)

prompt.description: optional: what to separate, in words

size.description: output size tier (default '1.5K'; '2K' costs more per picture)

text.description: false = skip reading the words out (default on)

name: layerize_image
title: Split an image into editable layers
